text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each mark is an XGBoost model's error, given one forecast product. The two row sets hold different hours, so their axes are separate and their errors cannot be read against each other or against the other figures. Every arm on a row set is scored on the same hours. Points of capacity; negative means the first forecast in a row is better. AIFS steps every 6 hours, so the ENS references use 6-hourly steps too. Hourly-step IFS 0.25° has a lead no longer than AIFS's and favours IFS 0.25°. The XGBoost models ran on a graphics processing unit. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Scored hours of the three wind farms in Lincolnshire, March 2025 to September 2026. Every error is a fraction of the generator's own capacity, taken as its 99th percentile of metered output. No row was planned in the study's published plan. The row marked Deciding was named before any AIFS fit; the AIFS ENS rows are descriptive; every other row is exploratory.'
text.tspan: Each mark is an XGBoost model's error, given one forecast product. The two row sets hold different hours, so their
axes are separate and their errors cannot be read against each other or against the other figures. Every arm on a
row set is scored on the same hours. Points of capacity; negative means the first forecast in a row is better.
AIFS steps every 6 hours, so the ENS references use 6-hourly steps too. Hourly-step IFS 0.25° has a lead no longer
than AIFS's and favours IFS 0.25°. The XGBoost models ran on a graphics processing unit. Dot: estimate. Line: 95%
interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed.
Scored hours of the three wind farms in Lincolnshire, March 2025 to September 2026. Every error is a fraction of
the generator's own capacity, taken as its 99th percentile of metered output.
No row was planned in the study's published plan. The row marked Deciding was named before any AIFS fit; the AIFS
ENS rows are descriptive; every other row is exploratory.
